senses.gloss:
जघन जघन, i. e. reduplicated हन् + अ, n. and m.
 1. The pudenda, Hariv. 8625.
 2. The buttocks, Rām. 5, 18, 11.
 3. The rear-guard of an army, MBh. 3, 16284.
 --Cf. κοχώνη.
जघनिन् जघनिन्, i. e. जघन + इन्, adj., f. नी, Having large buttocks, Hariv. 9547.

जघन्य जघन्य, i. e. जघन + य, adj., f. या.
 1. Last, MBh. 3, 1366.
 2. Late, MBh. 12, 4794.
 3. Shortest, Suśr. 1, 125, 5.
 4. Indifferent, Suśr. 1, 95, 14.
 5. Lowest, Man. 8, 270; Pañc. iii. d. 218.
 6. Comparat. जघन्यतर, Lower, MBh. 14, 1137.
 7. ˚यम्, adv. At last, MBh. 3, 905.
 8. loc. ये, adverbially, [] At last, MBh. 3, 1303; Behind, Hariv. 3087.
जघन्यतस् जघन्य + तस्, adv. At last, Rām. 5, 40, 5.
जाघनी जाघनी, i. e. जघन + अ + ई, f. The tail, MBh. 12, 5375; Man. 10, 108.
जघन-स्थली जघन-स्थली, f. the buttocks, Śiś. 9, 45.
